transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… well, people keep saying the foreclosure is just paperwork, missed payments, that kind of thing. But it’s not that simple. The bank, the loan servicer… and even some people at my job, I think they’ve been working together to push me out of my house. This has been going on almost two years, and the papers they show me don’t change what I’ve seen.
How long have you believed that the bank, the loan servicer, and people at your job have been working together against you?
About a year and nine months, I guess. Since the foreclosure notices started coming and the bank calls were… just taking over everything at home.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that others around you don’t seem to hear?
I don’t think so. I mean… I hear normal things, but not voices like that.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs that others might not share, like thinking someone is trying to harm you or that you have special powers?

Not special powers, no. Just… what I already said. I know the bank and the loan servicer, and some people at work, have been quietly working together to get me out of my house. People keep saying it’s just foreclosure paperwork, but I’ve seen enough over almost two years. The papers don’t change that.

Have you ever doubted or questioned your belief that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job have been working together against you, even a little, when others have presented you with evidence that it might not be true?

No. I mean… people keep showing me papers and saying it’s just missed payments and foreclosure steps, but that doesn’t change what I’ve seen. The bank, the loan servicer, people at work… they’ve been working together quietly. I know that.
Have you ever considered, even for a moment, that your belief about the bank, loan servicer, and coworkers working against you might not be true?

No. Not really. I’m here because everyone keeps acting like it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, but… I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, even people at my job—there’s something going on there. They’ve been working together quietly to push me out, and papers don’t change that.
Can you tell me more about how the bank, the loan servicer, and your coworkers have been working together against you?

It’s… hard to explain because people make it sound like I’m making connections that aren’t there. But I’ve watched it for almost two years. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at work all moving in the same direction, quietly, like they want me out of my house.

They keep showing me paperwork and saying it’s missed payments or foreclosure steps, but that doesn’t change what I’ve seen. It’s not just paperwork.
Have you ever had a close friend or family member who also believed the same thing about the bank, loan servicer, or your coworkers working against you?
I don’t really know. I haven’t… talked to many people about it like that. People mostly just tell me I’m reading too much into things, so I stopped bringing it up.

Have you ever felt that your belief about the bank, loan servicer, and coworkers working against you was so strong that no one could convince you otherwise, even if they tried to explain things differently?

Yes. I mean… people have tried to explain it differently. They keep saying it’s just missed payments and foreclosure paperwork.

But I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, even people at my job… they’ve been quietly working together to push me out of my house. That’s been going on for almost two years. So no, papers don’t really change that for me.
